scope: Owned synthetic UI acceptance for native template custom fields; no legacy additional_info writes.

environment.authentication: Owned synthetic tenantA session; no token copied into evidence.

sourceFreeze.rootVerification: 85 source files; zero drift at freeze. No source edits after freeze.

unknownSaveRecovery.description: One real PATCH initially returned an unknown outcome after the earlier owned-role write denial. The modal retained the locked form and original attempt; HMR-only retry visibility fix revealed an in-modal retry button without remounting. Retrying the same retained attempt succeeded; the field appeared exactly once. No request body, auth token, idempotency key, or secret was archived.

nullableNumberEdit.description: Edited the existing null-valued number field to 0 and read back 0.

enablement.description: Enabled the new numeric field and read back enabled=true.

unusedFieldDelete.description: Confirmed deletion of the test-only numeric field; its row was absent after the follow-up read.

usedFieldConflict.description: Confirmed deletion of legacyMode, which has a saved device value. UI showed the existing-value conflict; the delete dialog closed and the row remained. The UI permits changing only its default from Safe to Manual because that does not invalidate the saved safe value; this change was expected and read back.

nullableEnum.description: Created and read back an enum with defaultValue=null, one option, and enabled=false.

persistenceRefresh.description: Direct reload canonicalized /device/config-detail to /device/template/detail while preserving the template id query. The template detail API returned HTTP 200 and the detail component DOM rendered. The final API-backed table read showed legacyMode, zeroCount, emptyValue, and the nullable enum field with null default.

boundaries: Synthetic local auth only; real identity provider is not exercised.
No runtime activation or legacy groups migration was exercised.
No secret response content, session token, request key, or request body was saved.

Fixture limitation: /proxy-default/logo and /proxy-default/sys_version return 404 in this owned local environment; their independent generic toast was initially misattributed to the template route and is documented as corrected in the event log.

A prior diagnostic exposed one owned synthetic credential secret in a tool trace; the secret was cleared from the active view and that test credential was revoked. This does not claim every historical tool trace is secret-free.
